turns.answer: Wasalt Auctions are timed online auctions where real estate assets (and movable assets) are listed by Sales Agents—private sellers or Infath (Entrustment and Liquidation Center). Wasalt acts solely as an intermediary platform; it does not own, sell, warrant, or not guaranteed any asset. Bidders compete to determine the final price. Each auction has its own additional terms. If a winning bidder fails to complete payment within the specified period, the sale may be cancelled, the bid deposit retained, and the asset re‐listed. The winning bidder and Sales Agent are jointly responsible for government fees, transfer, registration, and similar charges.
